correctness.rationale: The 3 constant necklaces and 8 triple necklaces partition all 27 three-mers into eleven disjoint directed cycles; thus a minimum hitting set needs at least eleven vertices and every equality candidate is exactly one transversal of these classes. This reduces the entire finite problem to 3^8=6561 candidates. An independent Python implementation enumerated all transversals, tested residual DAGs via Kahn topological elimination, computed longest paths, independently enumerated 3 two-cycles and 18 four-cycles, verified the exact 5436/1041/84 rejection/acceptance partition, and split 84 acyclic masks 60/24; it separately reconstructed all seven symmetry orbits of size 12. The character-length translation is exact: h residual vertices correspond to an avoiding word of length h+2, next length h+3 forced. Exhaustiveness rests on necklace partition, not truncation.
